messages:
Maya (Events): 10m until live. Quick alert: slides v3 has last-minute metric tweak. Denise can you confirm final deck is uploaded to drive?
Denise (Product): uploading now. filename: allhands_deck_v3_final.pptx -> /drive/company/allhands/1766554321
ops-bot: file-upload: /drive/company/allhands/allhands_deck_v3_final.pptx at 1766554330
Robin (AV): AV heads-up: captions master and captions-fallback are out of sync by ~3-5s on the preview. if we swap sources mid-deck viewers will see jumps.
Maya (Events): Noted. We'll keep master for live and enable fallback only if encoder drops. Callout during introductions about ~5s captions lag.
Kai (Eng): checking encoder-1 logs for jitter. small packet drops between 1766554300-1766554320, increasing retransmits. switching jitter buffer to conservative mode. command: `sudo /opt/encctl set-jitter-buffer conservative`
Robin (AV): Good call. Also setting backup-recording to low-res to avoid saturating capture disk: `set-recording-quality low`
Denise (Product): Also FYI leadership wants the roadmap slide to mention "Reserved Dedicated expansion in Q3" exactly as written.
Eve (CEO): Confirmed. I'll say that and invite follow-ups. Please remind folks to tag #post-allhands with "followup:" prefix.
Maya (Events): Mic-check in 3. Robin, any audio hiss risk?
Robin (AV): There's a slight hum on presenter channel when laptop running on battery. recommend presenter plug into power or switch to headset.
Denise (Product): I'll ask presenter to plug in.
ops-bot: encoder: jitter-buffer set to conservative at 1766554345
Kai (Eng): mirroring ingest to encoder-2 for quick failover. command: `/usr/bin/ingest-switch --to encoder-2 --mirror`
Robin (AV): mirror accepted. preview shows duplicate but green. captions latency still ~4s on fallback, call it out.
Maya (Events): We will. Recording policy: stop +90s to ensure handoff capture. Ops please keep archive retention 30 days for raw then prod clips to highlights bucket.
Kai (Eng): Archive job scheduled: `archive --retain 30d --dest /archives/allhands/1766554321`
Denise (Product): For Q&A: if a question needs legal/security, tag the thread and prefix with "followup: legal" or "followup: security" so we can route.
Eve (CEO): I'll answer roadmap & high-level infra Qs during live and mark followups.
Maya (Events): Rolling in 60s. reminders: 1) mention captions lag 2) mention followup tagging 3) deck v3 updated. ready?
Denise (Product): Ready.
Robin (AV): Ready. OBS scenes synced, backup recording running low-res.
ops-bot: recording: backup-recorder-lowres started at 1766554370
Maya (Events): Go time. thanks everyone. :rocket:
